ts12_04_review.review.md:
## risk
The retry loop discards every earlier response and returns only the last attempt, so a transient success followed by a failure is reported as a failure.

## test gap
There is no test covering attempts greater than one, so the loop's return-value selection is unverified.

## Overview

The tool reads one input file and writes one report.

- `--old-flag VALUE`: deprecated alias of `--new-flag`; still accepted.
